caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate creamer pitcher positioned upright in the center of the composition. The pitcher is rendered in shades of silver, white, and gray, with highlights reflecting off its metallic surface to indicate shine and curvature. The creamer has an elongated, curved spout and a high, rounded handle, both detailed with small decorative flourishes. Its bulbous body features intricate relief designs, including leaves, flowers, and grape clusters, which are carefully shaded to show depth and texture. The base is broad, footed, and similarly decorated with raised floral motifs. The background is a flat, muted grayish-brown color, with the pitcher casting a faint shadow beneath it. Handwritten text appears in the lower right corner, identifying the object as a creamer with a catalog number, height, and the artist's name, Eugene Darrell. The lower left corner contains a small, labeled “CASE #5.” The drawing is bordered by a thin, single-line frame, and the paper edges show slight discoloration.
title: Silver Creamer
